open_questions: CV6320 is filed under 'Additive packages/LUBRIZOL' but is a component ('Ashless Antiwear Performance Booster', DL2-12015.pdf p.1). Not a VM or PPD, so only general.json is created.

Chemical family is not named. SDS DL2-12016.pdf p.2 Section 3 lists 'Olefin sulfide 1 - 5%', 'Ethoxylated alcohol 0.5 - 1%' and '++ Aryl thiophosphate (597-82-0) 0.1 - 0.5%' (component shares); chemical_family and active_content left Missing.
Function-specific marker not in template: SULFUR 0.60 (% weight, Typical; DL2-12015.pdf p.1).

Physical properties (no field in the component template), DL2-12015.pdf p.1 (Target column): FLASH POINT, C, PMCC 181; POUR POINT, C -21; SPECIFIC GRAVITY @ 15.6 C 0.849 / 0.869 / 0.889 (min/target/max); VISCOSITY @ 100 C, CST 69; VISCOSITY @ 40 C, CST 787; LBS PER U.S. GAL @ 15.6 C 7.24. SDS DL2-12016.pdf p.4-5 prints the same: flash 181 °C (Pensky-Martens Closed Cup), relative density 0,849 - 0,889 (15,6 °C), 787 mm2/s (40 °C), 69 mm2/s (100 °C), pour point -21 °C.
SDS supplier block names LUBRIZOL FRANCE (Rouen); TDS is The Lubrizol Corporation. SDS Issue Date 21.12.2017, Version 1.1.

[History] 2026-10-17: Ca, Mg, Zn, Mo markers set to N/A (ashless booster); P marker remains Missing. Changed back to Missing (2026-10 audit): the N/A status was inferred from the product type and SDS composition; the template does not exclude these markers and absent elements are not inferred. Confirm Ca, Mg, Zn, Mo and P contents with Lubrizol.
